what:
Arp Wav 09 is a minimalist & instinctive FirmWare, for the Fm-1.

Feels like an analog synthesizer again.

I disabled all the Fm-1’s keys. Only the Home key stays active.
Everything is played with knobs. Experiment with the three voices.
No sound preset. You play with the synthesizer's signal in real time.

Three voices.
ARP / WAV / A09..
author: Wav.09.02
